title: Still in school, the band as a bunch of kids
summary: He was still in school and living with his parents at about 16; the drummer was the youngest at 14.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Were you working full-time as a musician then?
No, I was still going to school. I was still living with my parents and I was still going to school at that time.
And you only, what, 17 or 18 years old?
I know I was 16. I had to be 16. I graduated from school when I was 17. So I must have been 16 or younger. I was real young.
I think everybody got into it kind of young. A lot of people started.
Yeah. Our drummer, he was 15. No, he was 14 because he was the youngest one in the band. And we all were just a bunch of kids. We might as well say a bunch of babies, you know.
Had you all sang together in the church and things like that?

No, not really. No. We all met during the school. And what happened? No, how that came about, we used to be together quite often and walking around different places. And whenever we'd go out, we'd always go together. And we'd walk down the street singing. So that's how the humming came about.
